Figure 01. Workflow illustration based on the application source; this is not an application screenshot.

Question

How can someone turn inconsistent operational reports into a useful decision without losing sight of the underlying assumptions?

Method

Recognize supported report structures, normalize records, and expose the inventory settings that influence the output.

Result

An inspectable workflow for importing reports, reviewing product performance, adjusting assumptions and exporting analysis.

Limitations

The importer supports recognized structures. Outputs depend on source quality and chosen assumptions. No measured business impact is claimed.

Initiative through tools

Build around the analytical workflow.

Make failures visible.

A file that produces zero usable rows receives an explicit error. That makes an unsupported or problematic input visible before someone trusts the report.

Recompute once per batch.

Imported files are parsed before a single update to the shared analysis state. This avoids repeating the full analysis after every file in a batch.

Let people finish an assumption.

Numeric edits commit on Enter or when leaving a field; growth sliders commit on release. The analysis updates when the user has finished the adjustment.

The source is not publicly available. The case study describes verified local implementation; it does not imply a public product demo.
